title: Lightly Crispy Greek Yellow Split Peas Pasta
description: A comforting and flavorful Greek dish featuring yellow split peas and a crispy pasta topping, made with a low-fat friendly emulsion sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until darkened in color.
Add the dried yellow split peas, lemon juice, and 2 cups of water to the skillet, bringing to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the peas are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add to the skillet, tossing to combine with the pea mixture.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with crumbly feta cheese.
Broil in the oven until the top is lightly crispy and golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
